name: Executive Readout
description: High-level presentation deck for C-level briefings and board meetings.
prompt_template:
Generate an executive readout presentation for {spec_name} using the messaging framework below.

GROUNDING CONTEXT:
{context}

Generate exactly 6 slides as a JSON array. Each slide must have:
- "layout": one of ["title", "exec_summary", "content", "data_focus", "comparison", "closing"]
- "heading": slide heading (max 6 words, executive tone)
- "content": array of strings (bullet points, max 4 per slide)
- "notes": speaker notes (2-3 sentences for executive audience — focus on ROI, risk, decision criteria)
- "metrics": optional array of {"label":"...","value":"..."} objects

Slide structure:
1. Title Slide — company, tagline, "Executive Readout"
2. Executive Summary — 3 bullet points covering situation, resolution, business impact
3. Situation — current state context (1 paragraph)
4. Complication — risk/downside if no action (1 paragraph)
5. Resolution + Business Case — 3 quantified outcomes or ROI data points
6. Recommendation — decision needed, next steps with owners

Output ONLY valid JSON array. No markdown fences.
